phrase.text: After a syntax error, the engine looks for a safe point to keep reading: that way it reports every independent error at once, each one only once.

runs.text: After a syntax error, the engine looks for a safe point to keep reading: that way it reports every independent error at once, each one only once.
When a statement is badly written, analysis does not stop. It discards what it does not understand up to a
point —the end of the line, a
or the edge of a block— and continues from there. Every broken statement produces
main diagnostic, and errors that fall on discarded text are not reported.

caption.text: Each error discards up to the next safe point and analysis continues. Correct lines are recognised as usual.

runs.text: Diagnostics are published in a fixed order that does not depend on the language or on when they were found: first by phase (lexical, syntactic, semantic), then by position, length and code.

entries.text: At most one hundred main syntax diagnostics are reported. When the cap is reached,
Even an empty or completely invalid text produces a tree: the editor always has something to work with.

points.text: After an error, analysis synchronizes and continues.
A broken statement gives at most one main diagnostic.
An unclosed block gives a single diagnostic.
The order is fixed: phase, position, length and code.
